product.description: Monoprice™ EZ™ SeriesFull‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount BracketFor 23" to 65" flat and curved TVs weighing up to 77 poundsSpecifically designed for easy installation, this Monoprice™ EZ™ Series Full‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount Bracket features a simple design with solid holding power. The full‑motion design allows you to adjust your TV for the most comfortable viewing angle, no matter where you choose to sit. Constructed of cold‑rolled steel, it can swivel up to 90° side‑to‑side, tilts from +5° ~ ‑15°, rotates ±3°, and can extend from 1.9" to 20.3" from the wall. It is designed for curved or flat screen TVs from 23" ~ 65" weighing up to 77 pounds, with VESA® mounting patterns from 75x75 to 400x400.Fits VESA® patterns from 75x75 to 400x400Designed for 23" to 65" displaysSwivels ±90 degreesTilts +5 ~ ‑15 degreesRotates ±3 degrees77 pounds weight capacityExtends from 1.9" to 20.3" from the wallDesigned to work with both flat and curved displaysBuilt‑in cable managementUL® certified FULL‑MOTION ARTICULATING WALL MOUNTMonoprice™ full‑motion wall mounts offer the ultimate in comfort and flexibility. The articulated swing arm allows you to move the TV towards or away from the wall, tilt it up or down, and angle it from side‑to‑side. The articulating plate holding the TV also allows you to rotate the TV to ensure it is level. "IS THIS MOUNT COMPATIBLE WITH MY TV?"Check your TV's manual for its VESA® mounting pattern or measure the horizontal and vertical distances between the mounting holes (in mm).This mount supports VESA patterns between 75x75 and 400x400.This mount supports TVs weighing up to 77 pounds.The screen size range is only a suggested approximation.
